question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

The recent discoveries have risen hopes about possible applications.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1, "have risen hopes."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is **"have raised hopes,"** not **"have risen hopes."**
 
• **"Raised"** is the correct past participle of **"raise," **while &q
